soru: Bilim insanları, iklim değişikliğinin kutup ayılarının yaşam alanlarını tehdit ettiği konusunda uyarıyor.
secenekler: Polar bears are adapting to their new habitats despite the warnings of scientists.
Scientists are unsure whether climate change threatens polar bears' habitats.
Climate change has not threatened the habitats of polar bears, according to scientists.
Scientists warned that polar bears would threaten their habitats because of climate change.
Scientists warn that climate change is threatening the habitats of polar bears.
aciklama: Özne 'bilim insanları', yüklem 'uyarıyor' (warn), tehdit eden 'iklim değişikliği'dir; diğer seçeneklerde özne, zaman veya olumsuzluk değişmiştir.

soru: Yeni ilacın yan etkileri, beklenenden çok daha hafif çıktı.
secenekler: The new drug turned out to have no side effects at all, unlike what was expected.
The new drug had far more severe side effects than had been expected.
The side effects of the new drug were expected to be much milder.
The side effects of the new drug turned out to be much milder than expected.
As expected, the new drug caused only mild side effects.
aciklama: '…çıktı' = turned out to be; 'beklenenden çok daha hafif' = much milder than expected.

soru: Şehirlerdeki hava kirliliği azaltılmadıkça, solunum yolu hastalıklarının artmaya devam etmesi muhtemeldir.
secenekler: Respiratory diseases will continue to increase even if air pollution in cities is reduced.
Unless air pollution in cities is reduced, respiratory diseases are likely to continue increasing.
If air pollution in cities is not reduced, respiratory diseases may soon decrease.
Air pollution in cities is likely to increase because of the rise in respiratory diseases.
As air pollution in cities has been reduced, respiratory diseases have stopped increasing.
aciklama: '-madıkça' = unless; 'muhtemeldir' = be likely to; 'artmaya devam etmek' = continue increasing.

soru: Arkeologların bulduğu aletler, bölgede sanıldığından çok daha önce yerleşim olduğunu gösteriyor.
secenekler: It had been thought that archaeologists would find tools showing an early settlement in the region.
The tools that archaeologists found show that the region was settled later than was believed.
The tools found by archaeologists suggest that the region was settled much earlier than had been thought.
Archaeologists are searching the region for tools from a much earlier settlement.
Archaeologists had thought that the tools found in the region were much older than they are.
aciklama: Özne 'aletler', yüklem 'gösteriyor'; 'sanıldığından çok daha önce' = much earlier than had been thought.

soru: Düzenli olarak kitap okumak kelime bilgisini geliştirir.
secenekler: Reading books regularly improves vocabulary.
Improving vocabulary makes it easier to read books regularly.
People who read books regularly have no need to improve their vocabulary.
Vocabulary cannot be improved by reading books.
Reading books occasionally is enough to improve vocabulary.
aciklama: Özne 'düzenli kitap okumak' (Reading books regularly), yüklem 'geliştirir' (improves).

soru: Toplantı, müdürün uçağı rötar yaptığı için ertelendi.
secenekler: Although the manager's flight was delayed, the meeting started on time.
The meeting was postponed because the manager's flight was delayed.
The meeting will be postponed if the manager's flight is delayed.
The manager postponed his flight because of the meeting.
The manager's flight was delayed because the meeting was postponed.
aciklama: Sebep 'uçağın rötar yapması', sonuç 'toplantının ertelenmesi'dir; neden-sonuç yönü korunmalıdır.

soru: Araştırmacılar, bu türün nesli tükenmeden önce onu korumak için acil önlemler alınması gerektiğini vurguluyor.
secenekler: According to researchers, it is too late to take urgent measures to protect this species.
Researchers emphasise that this species can protect itself without any urgent measures.
Researchers stress that urgent measures must be taken to protect this species before it becomes extinct.
Researchers claim that this species became extinct although urgent measures were taken.
Urgent measures taken by researchers have saved this species from extinction.
aciklama: 'vurguluyor' = stress, 'alınması gerektiği' = must be taken, 'nesli tükenmeden önce' = before it becomes extinct.

soru: Bu ilacın uzun vadeli etkileri henüz tam olarak bilinmemektedir.
secenekler: The long-term effects of this drug have been fully studied.
The short-term effects of this drug are well known, unlike its long-term effects.
It will never be possible to know the long-term effects of this drug.
The long-term effects of this drug are not yet fully known.
This drug has no long-term effects, as far as is known.
aciklama: 'henüz tam olarak bilinmemektedir' = are not yet fully known. Kısa vadeli etkiler cümlede geçmez.

soru: Nüfus arttıkça temiz suya olan talep de artmaktadır.
secenekler: The population is growing so slowly that the demand for clean water remains the same.
The demand for clean water has caused the population to grow.
Although the population is growing, the demand for clean water is decreasing.
If the population stopped growing, the demand for clean water would disappear.
As the population grows, the demand for clean water also increases.
aciklama: '-dıkça' eş zamanlı artışı bildirir → 'As ...'; 'de artmaktadır' = also increases.

soru: Deneyin sonuçları, başlangıçta öne sürülen hipotezi desteklemek bir yana, onunla tamamen çelişiyordu.
secenekler: Far from supporting the hypothesis put forward at the beginning, the results of the experiment completely contradicted it.
Because the results supported the initial hypothesis, the experiment was considered a complete success.
The results of the experiment neither supported nor contradicted the initial hypothesis.
The hypothesis put forward at the beginning was changed so that it would be supported by the results.
The results of the experiment partly supported the hypothesis that had been put forward at the beginning.
aciklama: '…mek bir yana' = far from + -ing; 'tamamen çelişiyordu' = completely contradicted.

soru: Kütüphane saat dokuzda açılır.
secenekler: The library will open at nine o'clock tomorrow.
The library opened at nine o'clock yesterday.
The library is open until nine o'clock.
The library closes at nine o'clock.
The library opens at nine o'clock.
aciklama: Geniş zaman 'açılır' → 'opens'.

soru: Dün akşam arkadaşlarımla sinemaya gittim.
secenekler: I go to the cinema with my friends every night.
I went to the cinema with my friends last night.
I have never been to the cinema with my friends.
I will go to the cinema with my friends tonight.
My friends went to the cinema without me last night.
aciklama: 'Dün akşam ... gittim' → Simple Past, 'with my friends'.

soru: Bu kitabı henüz okumadım.
secenekler: I haven't read this book yet.
I read this book last year.
I have already read this book.
I am reading this book now.
I will never read this book.
aciklama: 'henüz ...madım' → 'haven't ... yet'.

soru: Sigara içmek sağlığa zararlıdır.
secenekler: Smoking is good for health.
Smoking may be harmless to health.
Stopping smoking is harmful to health.
Smoking is harmful to health.
Smoking was harmful to his health.
aciklama: 'Sigara içmek' = Smoking; 'zararlıdır' = is harmful.

soru: Hava çok soğuk olduğu için dışarı çıkmadık.
secenekler: If it is cold, we won't go out.
Although it was very cold, we went out.
We didn't go out because it was very cold.
It got cold after we went out.
We went out because the weather was nice.
aciklama: '-duğu için' = because; 'çıkmadık' = didn't go out.

soru: Annem her sabah erkenden kalkar.
secenekler: My mother gets up early every morning.
My mother got up early this morning.
My mother will get up early tomorrow.
My mother used to get up early every morning.
My mother never gets up early.
aciklama: 'her sabah ... kalkar' → alışkanlık, Simple Present.

soru: Yarın hava güzel olursa pikniğe gideceğiz.
secenekler: We went on a picnic although the weather was bad.
Unless the weather is nice tomorrow, we will go on a picnic.
The weather will be nice tomorrow, so we are having a picnic today.
If the weather is nice tomorrow, we will go on a picnic.
If the weather were nice, we would go on a picnic.
aciklama: '-ursa ... -eceğiz' → Type 1.

soru: Bu şehirde on yıldır yaşıyorum.
secenekler: I have lived in this city since ten years.
I will live in this city for ten years.
I am going to live in this city in ten years.
I lived in this city ten years ago.
I have been living in this city for ten years.
aciklama: 'on yıldır yaşıyorum' → 'have been living for ten years'; 'since' süreyle kullanılmaz.

soru: Öğrencilerin sınavda sözlük kullanmasına izin verilmedi.
secenekler: The teacher used a dictionary in the exam.
The students were not allowed to use dictionaries in the exam.
The students must use dictionaries in the exam.
The students didn't want to use dictionaries in the exam.
The students were allowed to use dictionaries in the exam.
aciklama: 'izin verilmedi' = were not allowed.

soru: Bu çanta o kadar ağırdı ki taşıyamadım.
secenekler: Although the bag was heavy, I carried it.
The bag was too light to carry.
The bag was so heavy that I couldn't carry it.
The bag was light enough for me to carry.
I carried the bag because it was heavy.
aciklama: 'o kadar ... ki' = so ... that.

soru: Kardeşim benden üç yaş büyüktür.
secenekler: My brother is three years older than me.
My brother is three years younger than me.
I am three years older than my brother.
My brother and I are the same age.
My brother was three years old.
aciklama: 'benden üç yaş büyük' = three years older than me.

soru: Toplantı iki saat sürdü.
secenekler: The meeting will last two hours.
The meeting ended two hours ago.
The meeting lasted two hours.
The meeting started two hours late.
The meeting was postponed for two hours.
aciklama: 'sürdü' geçmiş zamanda bir süre bildirir: 'last' fiilinin geçmişi 'lasted'. 'will last' gelecek zaman; 'ended' bitti, 'was postponed' ertelendi demektir.

soru: Lütfen kapıyı kapatır mısınız?
secenekler: You must not close the door.
Shall I open the door?
Did you close the door?
Why didn't you close the door?
Could you close the door, please?
aciklama: Kibar rica → 'Could you ..., please?'.

soru: Uzmanlara göre düzenli egzersiz depresyon riskini azaltabilir.
secenekler: Experts say that regular exercise increases the risk of depression.
According to experts, regular exercise can reduce the risk of depression.
According to experts, exercise has no effect on depression.
According to experts, depression prevents people from exercising regularly.
Experts do regular exercise to reduce their depression.
aciklama: '…e göre' = according to; 'azaltabilir' = can reduce.

soru: Yeni yasa gelecek aydan itibaren yürürlüğe girecek.
secenekler: The new law was cancelled a month ago.
The new law will be discussed next month.
The new law has been in force for a month.
The new law will come into force from next month.
The new law came into force last month.
aciklama: 'yürürlüğe girecek' = will come into force.

soru: Bilim insanları bu hastalığın nedenini hâlâ bilmiyor.
secenekler: The cause of this disease was known by scientists long ago.
Scientists have finally discovered the cause of this disease.
Scientists no longer study this disease.
Scientists still do not know the cause of this disease.
Scientists do not want to know the cause of this disease.
aciklama: 'hâlâ bilmiyor' = still do not know.

soru: Tren istasyona vardığımızda çoktan kalkmıştı.
secenekler: The train left as soon as we arrived at the station.
When we arrived at the station, the train had already left.
When we arrived at the station, the train was leaving.
We arrived at the station before the train left.
The train will have left when we arrive at the station.
aciklama: 'çoktan kalkmıştı' = had already left.

soru: Bu projeyi tamamlamak için daha fazla zamana ihtiyacımız var.
secenekler: This project needs to be completed immediately.
We don't need more time to complete this project.
We need more time to complete this project.
We completed this project in a short time.
We had more time than we needed for this project.
aciklama: '…e ihtiyacımız var' = we need; 'tamamlamak için' = to complete.

soru: Pek çok genç, iş bulamadığı için yurt dışına gitmeyi düşünüyor.
secenekler: Many young people went abroad and found jobs there.
Many young people can't go abroad because they have jobs.
Few young people want to go abroad to find a job.
Young people who go abroad cannot find a job.
Many young people are thinking of going abroad because they cannot find a job.
aciklama: 'gitmeyi düşünüyor' = are thinking of going; 'iş bulamadığı için' = because they cannot find a job.

soru: Şirket, kârı düşmesine rağmen hiçbir çalışanı işten çıkarmadı.
secenekler: Although its profits fell, the company did not lay off any employees.
The company did not make any profit, so it closed down.
The company's profits fell after it laid off its employees.
The company laid off some employees although its profits rose.
Because its profits fell, the company laid off many employees.
aciklama: '-mesine rağmen' = although; 'hiçbir çalışanı çıkarmadı' = did not lay off any employees.

soru: Ne kadar çok okursan kelime bilgin o kadar gelişir.
secenekler: If you had read more, your vocabulary would have improved.
Reading does not help your vocabulary improve.
The less you read, the more your vocabulary improves.
Your vocabulary improves only if you read a lot of newspapers.
The more you read, the more your vocabulary improves.
aciklama: 'Ne kadar çok ... o kadar' = The more ..., the more ...

soru: Bu ilaç hamile kadınlar tarafından kullanılmamalıdır.
secenekler: This medicine was developed for pregnant women.
This medicine should not be used by pregnant women.
Pregnant women can use this medicine safely.
Pregnant women must use this medicine.
This medicine doesn't have to be used by pregnant women.
aciklama: 'kullanılmamalıdır' = should not be used (edilgen, olumsuz zorunluluk).

soru: Keşke o gün daha dikkatli olsaydım.
secenekler: If I am careful, nothing will happen.
I will be more careful from now on.
I wish I were more careful now.
I wish I had been more careful that day.
I was very careful that day.
aciklama: 'Keşke ... olsaydım' (geçmiş) = I wish I had been.

soru: Müze, restorasyon çalışmaları tamamlanana kadar kapalı kalacak.
secenekler: The museum has been open since the restoration work began.
The restoration work will continue even after the museum reopens.
The museum will remain closed until the restoration work is completed.
The museum was closed after the restoration work was completed.
The museum will reopen before the restoration work is completed.
aciklama: 'tamamlanana kadar' = until ... is completed; 'kapalı kalacak' = will remain closed.

soru: Bu bölgedeki kuraklık, çiftçilerin yarısından fazlasını göç etmeye zorladı.
secenekler: The drought in this region has forced more than half of the farmers to migrate.
Although there was a drought in the region, most farmers stayed.
The drought in the region is expected to force half of the farmers to migrate.
More than half of the farmers migrated to this region to escape the drought.
The drought forced farmers from other regions to migrate here.
aciklama: 'yarısından fazlasını göç etmeye zorladı' = has forced more than half ... to migrate.

soru: Gıda fiyatlarındaki artış, özellikle düşük gelirli aileleri etkiledi.
secenekler: Low-income families were not affected by the rise in food prices.
Food prices have fallen, especially for low-income families.
The rise in food prices has affected all families equally.
The rise in food prices has particularly affected low-income families.
Low-income families have caused the rise in food prices.
aciklama: 'özellikle' = particularly; özne 'gıda fiyatlarındaki artış'.

soru: Bu sorunun çözümü sanıldığı kadar kolay değil.
secenekler: This problem has no solution at all.
The solution to this problem is not as easy as it is thought to be.
The solution to this problem is easier than was thought.
It is thought that the problem has an easy solution.
The problem was solved more easily than expected.
aciklama: 'sanıldığı kadar kolay değil' = not as easy as it is thought to be.

soru: Çocukların ekran başında geçirdiği süre her geçen yıl artıyor.
secenekler: The time children spend in front of screens is increasing every year.
Children spent less time in front of screens this year.
Children's screen time has remained the same for years.
The number of children with screens is decreasing every year.
Every year, children are told to spend less time in front of screens.
aciklama: Özne 'çocukların geçirdiği süre'; 'artıyor' = is increasing.

soru: Hükümet önlem almasaydı, salgın çok daha fazla insanı etkileyecekti.
secenekler: Even if the government had taken measures, the epidemic would have spread.
If the government takes measures, the epidemic will affect fewer people.
Had the government not taken measures, the epidemic would have affected many more people.
Because the government took no measures, the epidemic affected many people.
The government took measures after the epidemic had affected many people.
aciklama: 'almasaydı ... etkileyecekti' gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş koşuldur → 'Had ... not taken ... would have affected'.

soru: Araştırmacılar, uykusuzluğun hafızayı sanıldığından çok daha fazla etkilediğini ortaya koydu.
secenekler: Researchers revealed that people think about sleep more than memory.
It was thought that researchers had studied the effects of sleep on memory.
Researchers believe that memory problems cause sleep deprivation.
Researchers have shown that sleep deprivation has less effect on memory than expected.
Researchers have revealed that sleep deprivation affects memory far more than had been thought.
aciklama: 'sanıldığından çok daha fazla' = far more than had been thought.

soru: Ancak son yıllarda bilim insanları bu bölgenin ne kadar zengin bir biyolojik çeşitliliğe sahip olduğunu fark etmeye başladı.
secenekler: In recent years, scientists have realised that this region has no biodiversity.
Scientists have known for many years that this region is rich in biodiversity.
Only in recent years have scientists begun to realise how rich in biodiversity this region is.
In recent years, the biodiversity of this region has decreased dramatically.
Scientists began to study the region because it was poor in biodiversity.
aciklama: 'Ancak son yıllarda' = Only in recent years (devrik yapı); 'ne kadar zengin' = how rich.

soru: Deneyin başarısız olmasının nedeni basit bir hesaplama hatasıydı.
secenekler: The experiment was successful despite a simple calculation error.
The experiment failed although there were no calculation errors.
The calculation error was so complex that the experiment failed.
The reason why the experiment failed was a simple calculation error.
A simple calculation error was found after the experiment succeeded.
aciklama: 'başarısız olmasının nedeni' = the reason why ... failed.

soru: Ne kadar denerse denesin, sınavı geçmeyi başaramadı.
secenekler: Because he tried hard, he managed to pass the exam.
However hard he tried, he couldn't manage to pass the exam.
He managed to pass the exam on his first try.
If he had tried harder, he would have passed the exam.
He didn't try hard, so he failed the exam.
aciklama: 'Ne kadar denerse denesin' = However hard he tried.

soru: Toplantıya katılanların hiçbiri öneriye itiraz etmedi.
secenekler: The proposal was not discussed by anyone at the meeting.
Some of those who attended the meeting objected to the proposal.
Nobody attended the meeting, so the proposal was rejected.
All of those attending objected to the proposal.
None of those who attended the meeting objected to the proposal.
aciklama: 'katılanların hiçbiri' = none of those who attended.

soru: Bu kadar kısa sürede bu kadar çok ilerleme kaydedilmesi herkesi şaşırttı.
secenekler: It surprised everyone that so much progress had been made in such a short time.
Much progress was made, but it took a long time.
Everyone expected so much progress to be made in such a short time.
Everyone was surprised that little progress had been made in a long time.
No one was surprised by the progress that had been made.
aciklama: 'bu kadar kısa sürede bu kadar çok' = so much ... in such a short time; 'şaşırttı' = surprised.

soru: Hasta, ameliyattan sonraki ilk günlerde sıkı bir şekilde gözetim altında tutulmalıdır.
secenekler: The patient doesn't need to be monitored after the operation.
The patient was closely monitored before the operation.
The operation must be carried out in the first days after the diagnosis.
The patient must be closely monitored during the first days after the operation.
The patient must monitor his own condition after the operation.
aciklama: 'gözetim altında tutulmalıdır' = must be closely monitored (edilgen zorunluluk).

soru: Hava çok soğuk olmasına rağmen çocuklar bütün gün dışarıda oynadı.
secenekler: Although the weather was very cold, the children played outside all day.
If the weather had not been so cold, the children would have played outside.
The weather was so cold that the children could not play outside.
Because the weather was very cold, the children stayed inside all day.
The children played outside all day until the weather became very cold.
aciklama: '-mesine rağmen' = although; çocuklar soğuğa rağmen dışarıda oynadı.

soru: Şehirler büyüdükçe trafik sorunu daha da ciddi bir hâl alıyor.
secenekler: The traffic problem in growing cities has been solved.
The traffic problem prevents cities from growing.
Cities are growing because the traffic problem is becoming less serious.
Although cities are growing, the traffic problem is not serious.
As cities grow, the traffic problem becomes even more serious.
aciklama: 'büyüdükçe' = as cities grow; 'daha da ciddi' = even more serious.

soru: Bu bölgede yaklaşık beş bin yıl önce insanların yaşadığı tahmin ediliyor.
secenekler: People in this region have been living here for about five thousand years.
It is estimated that people lived in this region about five thousand years ago.
About five thousand people are estimated to live in this region today.
People are expected to live in this region in five thousand years.
It is known for certain that nobody lived in this region five thousand years ago.
aciklama: '…diği tahmin ediliyor' = it is estimated that; 'beş bin yıl önce' = five thousand years ago.

soru: Sözleşmeyi imzalamadan önce tüm maddeleri dikkatle okumalısınız.
secenekler: You should sign the contract without reading all the clauses.
You read all the clauses carefully after you signed the contract.
You should read all the clauses carefully before signing the contract.
Once you sign the contract, you can read all the clauses.
You do not need to read the clauses before signing the contract.
aciklama: '-meden önce' = before …ing; '-malısınız' = you should.

soru: Toplantıya ne müdür ne de yardımcısı katıldı.
secenekler: The meeting was held by the manager and his assistant.
Neither the manager nor his assistant attended the meeting.
Either the manager or his assistant will attend the meeting.
Both the manager and his assistant attended the meeting.
The manager attended the meeting, but his assistant did not.
aciklama: 'ne ... ne de' = neither ... nor.

soru: Daha erken yola çıksaydık uçağı kaçırmazdık.
secenekler: If we had set off earlier, we would not have missed the plane.
If we had not missed the plane, we would have set off earlier.
We set off early so that we would not miss the plane.
If we set off earlier, we will not miss the plane.
We missed the plane although we set off early.
aciklama: Geçmişe dair gerçekleşmemiş koşul: 'If we had set off earlier, we would not have missed'.

soru: Yol buzlu olduğu için sürücülerden dikkatli olmaları istendi.
secenekler: The road became icy because drivers were not careful.
Because drivers were careful, there were no accidents on the icy road.
Drivers asked the authorities to clear the icy road.
Although the road was icy, drivers were not warned.
Drivers were asked to be careful because the road was icy.
aciklama: '…olduğu için' = because; '…mesi istendi' = were asked to.

soru: Öğrencilerin çoğu sınavın beklediklerinden daha kolay olduğunu söyledi.
secenekler: A few students said that the exam was more difficult than expected.
The students said that the exam was as easy as they had expected.
Most of the students said that the exam was easier than they had expected.
All the students expected the exam to be easy.
Most of the students expected the exam to be more difficult than it was, but they failed.
aciklama: 'öğrencilerin çoğu' = most of the students; 'beklediklerinden daha kolay' = easier than they had expected.

soru: Fırtına nedeniyle uçak başka bir havalimanına inmek zorunda kaldı.
secenekler: The plane was able to land at the airport despite the storm.
The storm started after the plane landed at another airport.
Because of the storm, the plane could not take off.
The plane had to land at another airport because of the storm.
The plane took off from another airport to avoid the storm.
aciklama: 'inmek zorunda kaldı' = had to land; 'fırtına nedeniyle' = because of the storm.

soru: Bu ilaç hem ağrıyı azaltır hem de ateşi düşürür.
secenekler: This medicine lowers fever only when pain is reduced.
This medicine reduces pain but increases fever.
This medicine both reduces pain and lowers fever.
This medicine neither reduces pain nor lowers fever.
This medicine either reduces pain or lowers fever.
aciklama: 'hem ... hem de' = both ... and.

soru: Yeni model eski model kadar yakıt tüketmiyor.
secenekler: The new model does not consume as much fuel as the old one.
The new model consumes more fuel than the old one.
The old model was replaced because it consumed too little fuel.
The new model consumes exactly the same amount of fuel as the old one.
The old model does not consume as much fuel as the new one.
aciklama: '…kadar tüketmiyor' = does not consume as much as; yeni model daha az tüketir.

soru: Son yıllarda giderek daha fazla insan bisikletle işe gitmeye başladı.
secenekler: In recent years, fewer people have been cycling to work.
In recent years, people have started working in bicycle factories.
More people used to cycle to work in the past than they do now.
People have stopped cycling to work in recent years.
In recent years, more and more people have started cycling to work.
aciklama: 'giderek daha fazla' = more and more; 'bisikletle işe gitmeye başladı' = have started cycling to work.

soru: Düzenli egzersiz yaptığınız sürece kilo almanız pek olası değildir.
secenekler: You need to exercise regularly because you have gained weight.
Even if you exercise regularly, you are likely to gain weight.
If you exercise regularly, you will certainly gain weight.
As long as you exercise regularly, you are unlikely to gain weight.
Unless you gain weight, you do not need to exercise regularly.
aciklama: '…dığı sürece' = as long as; 'pek olası değil' = unlikely.

soru: Bu kitabı okuyacak kadar İngilizcem yok.
secenekler: My English is so good that I can read this book easily.
My English is not good enough to read this book.
This book is too easy for me to read.
I do not have enough time to read this book in English.
I read this book to improve my English.
aciklama: 'okuyacak kadar İngilizcem yok' = my English is not good enough to read.

soru: Bu müzeyi on yıldan beri ziyaret etmedim.
secenekler: I have been visiting this museum every year for ten years.
I will visit this museum again in ten years.
I visited this museum ten years ago for the first time.
I have not visited this museum for ten years.
This museum has been closed for ten years.
aciklama: 'on yıldan beri ziyaret etmedim' = I have not visited for ten years.

soru: Yağmur yağsa bile maç ertelenmeyecek.
secenekler: If it rains, the match will be postponed.
The match will be played only if it does not rain.
Unless it rains, the match will be postponed.
The match was postponed because it rained.
Even if it rains, the match will not be postponed.
aciklama: '…sa bile' = even if; 'ertelenmeyecek' = will not be postponed.

soru: Piramitlerin binlerce işçi tarafından inşa edildiğine inanılıyor.
secenekler: The pyramids were built to employ thousands of workers.
The pyramids are believed to have been built by thousands of workers.
It is known that the pyramids were built by slaves only.
Thousands of workers believe that the pyramids were built by a king.
Thousands of workers are believed to be building the pyramids now.
aciklama: '…inşa edildiğine inanılıyor' = are believed to have been built.

soru: Hükümetin işsizlik sorununu çözmek için acil önlemler alması gerekiyor.
secenekler: The government needs to take urgent measures to solve the problem of unemployment.
The government refuses to take measures against unemployment.
The government has already taken urgent measures to solve unemployment.
Unemployment is not a problem that requires urgent measures.
The government's urgent measures have caused unemployment.
aciklama: '…alması gerekiyor' = needs to take; 'çözmek için' = to solve.

soru: Eve vardığımda herkes çoktan uyumuştu.
secenekler: When I arrived home, everyone was waiting for me.
Everyone was still awake when I arrived home.
When I arrived home, everyone had already gone to sleep.
I went to sleep as soon as I arrived home.
Everyone went to sleep after I arrived home.
aciklama: 'vardığımda' = when I arrived; 'çoktan uyumuştu' = had already gone to sleep.

soru: Taksi yerine metroya binmeye karar verdik.
secenekler: We took both a taxi and the metro.
We decided to take a taxi instead of the metro.
We decided to take the metro instead of a taxi.
We could not decide whether to take a taxi or the metro.
We took a taxi because the metro was closed.
aciklama: 'taksi yerine' = instead of a taxi; 'metroya binmeye karar verdik' = decided to take the metro.

soru: Bir dili ne kadar çok konuşursanız o kadar akıcı hâle gelirsiniz.
secenekler: The less you speak a language, the more fluent you become.
The more you speak a language, the more fluent you become.
You speak a language fluently because you practise a lot.
Speaking a language fluently requires talking less.
You can become fluent in a language without speaking it.
aciklama: 'ne kadar çok … o kadar …' = the more ..., the more ...

soru: Kurtarma ekipleri enkaz altındaki tüm işçileri çıkarmayı başardı.
secenekler: Rescue teams managed to get out all the workers trapped under the rubble.
The workers managed to rescue the teams trapped under the rubble.
Some of the workers under the rubble were rescued by other workers.
Rescue teams could not reach the workers trapped under the rubble.
Rescue teams tried to reach the workers but failed.
aciklama: 'çıkarmayı başardı' = managed to get out; hepsi kurtarıldı.

soru: Araştırma, çocukların günde ortalama beş saat ekran başında geçirdiğini ortaya koydu.
secenekler: The research suggests that children should spend five hours a day in front of a screen.
The research showed that children spend less than five hours a week in front of a screen.
The research was conducted over five hours by children.
Children who spend five hours a day in front of a screen took part in the research.
The research revealed that children spend an average of five hours a day in front of a screen.
aciklama: 'ortaya koydu' = revealed; 'günde ortalama beş saat' = an average of five hours a day.

soru: Güneş doğar doğmaz yola çıktık.
secenekler: The sun rose after we had arrived.
We did not set off until the sun had set.
We set off long before the sun rose.
We set off as soon as the sun rose.
We waited for hours after the sun had risen.
aciklama: 'doğar doğmaz' = as soon as the sun rose.

soru: Yangının elektrik kaçağından çıktığı sanılıyor.
secenekler: An electrical fault was found after the fire had been put out.
It has been proved that the fire was started deliberately.
The fire is thought to have been caused by an electrical fault.
The fire started although there was no electrical fault.
The fire caused an electrical fault in the building.
aciklama: '…çıktığı sanılıyor' = is thought to have been caused by; kesinlik yok.

soru: Gürültü yüzünden dün gece hiç uyuyamadım.
secenekler: The noise woke me up early this morning.
I made a lot of noise last night because I could not sleep.
I slept a little last night because it was quiet.
I slept well last night despite the noise.
I could not sleep at all last night because of the noise.
aciklama: 'hiç uyuyamadım' = could not sleep at all; 'gürültü yüzünden' = because of the noise.

soru: Müze, ziyaretçilerin flaş kullanmadan fotoğraf çekmesine izin veriyor.
secenekler: The museum allows visitors to take photographs without using a flash.
Visitors are allowed to use a flash but not to take photographs.
The museum takes photographs of visitors without a flash.
Visitors must use a flash when taking photographs in the museum.
The museum does not allow visitors to take any photographs.
aciklama: '…mesine izin veriyor' = allows sb to; 'flaş kullanmadan' = without using a flash.

soru: Yoğun kar yağışından dolayı okullar üç gün tatil edildi.
secenekler: Schools remained open despite three days of heavy snowfall.
Schools were closed for three days due to heavy snowfall.
Heavy snow fell for three days after the schools were closed.
Students went on a three-day holiday to see the snow.
Schools will be closed for three days if it snows heavily.
aciklama: '…den dolayı' = due to; 'üç gün tatil edildi' = were closed for three days.

soru: Daha çok zamanım olsa yeni bir dil öğrenirdim.
secenekler: Although I have more time, I do not want to learn a new language.
If I had had more time, I would have learnt a new language.
If I have more time, I will learn a new language.
If I had more time, I would learn a new language.
I learnt a new language because I had more time.
aciklama: Şimdiye dair varsayım: 'olsa … öğrenirdim' = If I had ..., I would learn.

soru: Bu tür telefonlar artık üretilmiyor.
secenekler: This type of phone is no longer produced.
This type of phone has never been produced.
This type of phone is produced only in a few countries.
This type of phone will be produced again soon.
This type of phone is still produced in large numbers.
aciklama: 'artık üretilmiyor' = is no longer produced.

soru: Bilim insanları yeni aşıyı test etmek için gönüllü arıyor.
secenekler: Volunteers are looking for scientists to develop a new vaccine.
Scientists tested the new vaccine on themselves.
Scientists have found enough volunteers for the new vaccine.
Volunteers are testing the new vaccine without scientists.
Scientists are looking for volunteers to test the new vaccine.
aciklama: 'test etmek için gönüllü arıyor' = are looking for volunteers to test.

soru: Defalarca uyarıldığı hâlde sürücü hızını azaltmadı.
secenekler: The driver slowed down because he was warned several times.
The driver warned other drivers to slow down several times.
The driver slowed down before he was warned.
Although he was warned several times, the driver did not slow down.
The driver was not warned, so he did not slow down.
aciklama: '…dığı hâlde' = although; 'hızını azaltmadı' = did not slow down.

soru: Adayların hiçbiri iş için gerekli deneyime sahip değildi.
secenekler: The job did not require any experience.
The candidates gained experience after getting the job.
None of the candidates had the experience required for the job.
All the candidates had the experience required for the job.
Only one of the candidates had the necessary experience.
aciklama: 'adayların hiçbiri' = none of the candidates.

soru: Enflasyon oranı son altı aydır artmaya devam ediyor.
secenekler: The inflation rate has fallen steadily over the last six months.
The inflation rate has continued to rise for the last six months.
The inflation rate rose sharply six months ago but is now stable.
The inflation rate will start rising in six months.
The inflation rate stopped rising six months ago.
aciklama: 'son altı aydır artmaya devam ediyor' = has continued to rise for the last six months.

soru: Yazarın yeni romanını tamamlamak üzere olduğu söyleniyor.
secenekler: The writer is said to be about to finish her new novel.
The writer is said to have started a new novel.
The writer finished her new novel a long time ago.
The writer has said that she will never finish her new novel.
People say that the writer's new novel is not good.
aciklama: '…olduğu söyleniyor' = is said to; 'tamamlamak üzere' = about to finish.

soru: Mağaza gece yarısına kadar açık kalacak.
secenekler: The shop closed before midnight.
The shop stayed open all night.
The shop will stay open until midnight.
The shop will open at midnight.
The shop is open only after midnight.
aciklama: 'gece yarısına kadar açık kalacak' = will stay open until midnight.

soru: Aşırı şeker tüketimi diyabet riskini artırabilir.
secenekler: People with diabetes consume less sugar than others.
Diabetes can be prevented by consuming more sugar.
Excessive sugar consumption has no effect on diabetes.
The risk of diabetes decreases as sugar consumption increases.
Excessive sugar consumption can increase the risk of diabetes.
aciklama: 'artırabilir' = can increase; 'aşırı şeker tüketimi' = excessive sugar consumption.

soru: Gelecek ay açılması beklenen köprü iki şehir arasındaki yolculuğu kısaltacak.
secenekler: The journey between the two cities will be longer after the bridge opens.
The bridge, which is expected to open next month, will shorten the journey between the two cities.
The bridge will not open next month because the journey is too short.
The bridge that opened last month has shortened the journey between the two cities.
The two cities are expected to build a bridge next month.
aciklama: 'gelecek ay açılması beklenen köprü' = the bridge, which is expected to open next month; 'kısaltacak' = will shorten.

soru: Eve döndüğünde anahtarlarını ofiste unuttuğunu fark etti.
secenekler: She realised she had her keys only after she returned to the office.
She went back to the office because she had lost her keys at home.
When she left the office, she noticed that her keys were at home.
When she returned home, she realised that she had left her keys at the office.
She forgot her keys at home before going to the office.
aciklama: 'unuttuğunu fark etti' = realised that she had left; anahtarlar ofiste kaldı.

soru: Birçok hayvan türü iklim değişikliği nedeniyle yaşam alanını kaybediyor.
secenekler: Climate change has helped many animal species find new habitats.
Many animal species became extinct before climate change.
A few animal species are causing climate change.
Animal species are changing the climate of their habitats.
Many animal species are losing their habitats because of climate change.
aciklama: 'birçok hayvan türü' = many animal species; 'yaşam alanını kaybediyor' = are losing their habitats.

soru: Yüksek maliyetler nedeniyle şirket yeni fabrika kurmaktan vazgeçti.
secenekler: The company decided to build a new factory despite the high costs.
The company will build a new factory when costs rise.
Due to high costs, the company gave up building a new factory.
The new factory caused high costs for the company.
The company built a new factory to reduce high costs.
aciklama: 'kurmaktan vazgeçti' = gave up building; 'yüksek maliyetler nedeniyle' = due to high costs.

soru: Şehre taşındığından beri hiç hastalanmadı.
secenekler: She had never been ill before she moved to the city.
She moved to the city because she was often ill.
She has been ill since she moved to the city.
She has not been ill since she moved to the city.
She became ill soon after she moved to the city.
aciklama: 'taşındığından beri' = since she moved; 'hiç hastalanmadı' = has not been ill.

soru: Hükümet halka danışmaksızın yeni vergiyi yürürlüğe koydu.
secenekler: The new tax was introduced by the public without the government.
The government introduced the new tax without consulting the public.
The government consulted the public before introducing the new tax.
The public asked the government to introduce a new tax.
The government cancelled the new tax after consulting the public.
aciklama: 'danışmaksızın' = without consulting; 'yürürlüğe koydu' = introduced.

soru: İster otobüsle ister trenle gidin, yolculuk yaklaşık dört saat sürer.
secenekler: Whether you go by bus or by train, the journey takes about four hours.
If you go by train, the journey takes four hours less than by bus.
Neither the bus nor the train takes you there in four hours.
The journey takes four hours by bus but much longer by train.
You should go by train because the bus takes about four hours.
aciklama: 'ister ... ister' = whether ... or; süre ikisinde de aynı.

soru: Yazarın çocukluğunu geçirdiği ev şimdi bir müze olarak kullanılıyor.
secenekler: The writer bought a house near the museum where he worked as a child.
The museum was turned into a house for the writer's children.
The writer spent his childhood visiting museums.
The house where the writer spent his childhood is now used as a museum.
The writer's childhood home was demolished to build a museum.
aciklama: 'çocukluğunu geçirdiği ev' = the house where he spent his childhood; 'müze olarak kullanılıyor' = is used as a museum.

soru: Deniz seviyesi gittikçe yükseliyor.
secenekler: The sea level is rising steadily.
The sea level rose suddenly last year.
The sea level is falling slowly.
The sea level has never changed.
The sea level has stopped rising.
aciklama: 'gittikçe yükseliyor' = is rising steadily / gradually.

soru: Proje başlamadan önce daha ayrıntılı bir fizibilite çalışması yapılmalıydı.
secenekler: A feasibility study must be carried out after the project starts.
The project started because a detailed feasibility study was carried out.
A more detailed feasibility study should have been carried out before the project started.
No feasibility study is needed before the project starts.
A detailed feasibility study was carried out before the project started.
aciklama: 'yapılmalıydı' = should have been carried out (yapılmadı, eleştiri).

soru: Haberi duyunca herkes çok şaşırdı.
secenekler: Everyone expected the news, so no one was surprised.
Everyone was very surprised when they heard the news.
Everyone was surprised before the news was announced.
Nobody heard the news, so nobody was surprised.
The news surprised only a few people.
aciklama: 'duyunca' = when they heard; 'çok şaşırdı' = was very surprised.

soru: Başvurunuz kabul edildiği takdirde size e-posta ile bilgi verilecektir.
secenekler: You will be informed by email even if your application is rejected.
Unless you are informed by email, your application will be accepted.
You were informed by email that your application had been accepted.
Your application will be accepted only if you send an email.
If your application is accepted, you will be informed by email.
aciklama: '…dığı takdirde' = if; 'bilgi verilecektir' = you will be informed.

soru: Bu sorun ekonomik olmaktan çok siyasidir.
secenekler: This problem has economic causes and political effects.
This problem is political rather than economic.
This problem is more economic than political.
This problem is both economic and political.
This problem is neither economic nor political.
aciklama: '…olmaktan çok siyasi' = political rather than economic.

soru: Doktor, hastanın herhangi bir ilaca alerjisi olup olmadığını sordu.
secenekler: The doctor asked whether the patient was allergic to any medicine.
The doctor said that the patient was allergic to all medicines.
The patient asked the doctor whether the medicine had any side effects.
The doctor gave the patient a medicine for his allergy.
The doctor did not ask the patient about allergies.
aciklama: '…olup olmadığını sordu' = asked whether.

soru: Bu ilaç ancak doktor reçetesiyle satın alınabilir.
secenekler: Doctors rarely prescribe this medicine.
This medicine can be bought without a prescription.
This medicine is sold only to doctors.
This medicine can only be bought with a doctor's prescription.
A doctor's prescription is not valid for this medicine.
aciklama: 'ancak … ile' = only with; 'satın alınabilir' = can be bought.

soru: Kazanın sürücü hatasından kaynaklandığı anlaşıldı.
secenekler: It is still unclear what caused the accident.
The driver caused an error because he had an accident.
It was understood that the accident had been caused by driver error.
The driver understood that the accident was his fault but denied it.
The accident happened although the driver made no error.
aciklama: '…kaynaklandığı anlaşıldı' = it was understood that ... had been caused by.

soru: Film başlamak üzereyken sinemaya vardık.
secenekler: We arrived at the cinema after the film had ended.
We left the cinema before the film started.
The film started long before we arrived at the cinema.
The film was about to end when we left the cinema.
We arrived at the cinema just as the film was about to start.
aciklama: 'başlamak üzereyken' = was about to start; 'vardık' = we arrived.

soru: Bilet fiyatları çok yüksek olduğu için konsere gitmedik.
secenekler: Ticket prices were low, so we went to the concert.
We went to the concert although the ticket prices were very high.
The ticket prices went up after we went to the concert.
We did not go to the concert because the ticket prices were too high.
We could not find tickets for the concert, so we stayed at home.
aciklama: '…olduğu için' = because; 'gitmedik' = did not go.

soru: İstanbul dünyanın en kalabalık şehirlerinden biridir.
secenekler: Istanbul is one of the most crowded cities in the world.
Istanbul is one of the least crowded cities in the world.
Istanbul is the most crowded city in the world.
Istanbul is less crowded than most cities in the world.
Istanbul has become more crowded than any other city.
aciklama: 'en kalabalık şehirlerinden biri' = one of the most crowded cities.

soru: Ben kitap okurken kardeşim televizyon izliyordu.
secenekler: My brother read a book after he had watched television.
While I was reading a book, my brother was watching television.
I started reading a book when my brother turned off the television.
I was watching television while my brother was reading a book.
My brother and I watched television instead of reading.
aciklama: 'okurken' = while I was reading; 'izliyordu' = was watching. Özne-eylem eşleşmesi korunmalıdır.

soru: Son ankete göre halkın çoğu yeni yasayı destekliyor.
secenekler: According to the latest survey, only a few people support the new law.
Most of the public are against the latest survey.
According to the latest survey, most of the public support the new law.
The new law was introduced after the latest survey.
The latest survey was conducted to support the new law.
aciklama: '…e göre' = according to; 'halkın çoğu' = most of the public.

soru: Bitkilerin büyümesi için yeterli güneş ışığı alması gerekir.
secenekler: Too much sunlight prevents plants from growing.
Plants need less water when they get enough sunlight.
Sunlight grows faster when there are plants.
Plants grow well even without enough sunlight.
Plants need to get enough sunlight in order to grow.
aciklama: 'büyümesi için' = in order to grow; 'alması gerekir' = need to get.

soru: Bir toplumun gelişmişliği, kadınlara tanıdığı haklarla doğru orantılıdır.
secenekler: Developed societies are less interested in women's rights.
Women in developed societies have fewer rights than men.
A society grants rights to women only after it has developed.
The development of a society is directly proportional to the rights it grants to women.
The rights of women have nothing to do with the development of a society.
aciklama: '…ile doğru orantılıdır' = is directly proportional to; 'tanıdığı haklar' = the rights it grants.

soru: Bu hastalık hakkında şu ana kadar çok az şey biliniyor.
secenekler: This disease was discovered only a short time ago.
Few people have suffered from this disease so far.
Scientists know everything about this disease now.
A great deal is known about this disease.
Very little is known about this disease so far.
aciklama: 'çok az şey biliniyor' = very little is known; 'şu ana kadar' = so far.

soru: Beklendiği gibi faiz oranları bu ay yeniden yükseldi.
secenekler: Interest rates did not change this month, as expected.
Although nobody expected it, interest rates rose this month.
As expected, interest rates rose again this month.
Unexpectedly, interest rates fell this month.
Interest rates are expected to rise again next month.
aciklama: 'beklendiği gibi' = as expected; 'yeniden yükseldi' = rose again.

soru: Birçok çalışan işini kaybetmekten korktuğu için şikâyet etmiyor.
secenekler: Employees who complain are not afraid of losing their jobs.
Many employees do not complain because they are afraid of losing their jobs.
Many employees lost their jobs because they complained.
Many employees are afraid of complaining about their managers.
Many employees complain that they might lose their jobs.
aciklama: 'kaybetmekten korktuğu için' = because they are afraid of losing; 'şikâyet etmiyor' = do not complain.

soru: Bu yıl üretilen buğday miktarı geçen yılın iki katı.
secenekler: The amount of wheat produced this year is twice as much as last year's.
The amount of wheat produced this year is half of last year's.
Wheat production has been the same for the last two years.
This year's wheat production is slightly more than last year's.
Twice as much wheat was imported this year as last year.
aciklama: 'geçen yılın iki katı' = twice as much as last year's; 'üretilen' = produced.

soru: Şirket, ürünlerinin çevreye zarar vermediğini iddia ediyor.
secenekler: The company admits that its products harm the environment.
Environmental groups claim that the company's products are harmful.
It has been proved that the company's products do not harm the environment.
The company has stopped producing products that harm the environment.
The company claims that its products do not harm the environment.
aciklama: '…vermediğini iddia ediyor' = claims that ... do not harm.

soru: Tüm çabalarına rağmen takım finale kalamadı.
secenekler: The team did not make any effort, so they failed to reach the final.
The team reached the final without making much effort.
Despite all their efforts, the team failed to reach the final.
Thanks to all their efforts, the team reached the final.
The team made great efforts after they had reached the final.
aciklama: 'tüm çabalarına rağmen' = despite all their efforts; 'finale kalamadı' = failed to reach the final.

soru: Fırsat buldukça büyükannemi ziyaret ediyorum.
secenekler: I visited my grandmother once when I had the chance.
I visit my grandmother whenever I get the chance.
I will visit my grandmother when I have more time.
My grandmother visits me whenever she has the chance.
I rarely visit my grandmother because I am always busy.
aciklama: 'fırsat buldukça' = whenever I get the chance; şimdiki zamanda alışkanlık.

soru: Çocuklar genellikle bir yaşında yürümeyi öğrenir.
secenekler: Children cannot walk until they are two years old.
One-year-old children usually learn to run.
Children usually start talking before they are one year old.
Children usually learn to walk at the age of one.
Most children learn to walk after the age of three.
aciklama: 'yürümeyi öğrenir' = learn to walk; 'bir yaşında' = at the age of one.

soru: Bir ürünün pahalı olması her zaman kaliteli olduğu anlamına gelmez.
secenekler: The fact that a product is expensive does not always mean that it is of high quality.
Cheap products are usually of higher quality than expensive ones.
High-quality products are never expensive.
Expensive products are always of high quality.
A product is expensive because it is of high quality.
aciklama: '…olması … anlamına gelmez' = the fact that ... does not mean ...; 'her zaman' = always.

soru: Sorunları görmezden gelmek yerine onlarla yüzleşmeliyiz.
secenekler: We should ignore problems rather than face them.
We ignored the problems because we could not face them.
Facing problems is more difficult than ignoring them.
We should neither ignore nor face our problems.
Instead of ignoring problems, we should face them.
aciklama: 'görmezden gelmek yerine' = instead of ignoring; 'yüzleşmeliyiz' = we should face them.

soru: Hırsızlar ev sahipleri tatildeyken eve girdi.
secenekler: The burglars were caught by the owners when they returned from holiday.
The burglars broke into the house while the owners were on holiday.
The burglars went on holiday with the money they had stolen.
The owners went on holiday after the burglars had broken into the house.
The owners were at home when the burglars broke in.
aciklama: '…tatildeyken' = while the owners were on holiday; 'eve girdi' = broke into.

soru: Ne yazık ki toplantıya katılamayacağım.
secenekler: I will attend the meeting although I do not want to.
I am sorry that the meeting was cancelled.
Fortunately, I will be able to attend the meeting.
Unfortunately, I will not be able to attend the meeting.
Unfortunately, I could not attend the meeting yesterday.
aciklama: 'ne yazık ki' = unfortunately; 'katılamayacağım' = will not be able to attend.

soru: İnternetin yaygınlaşmasıyla birlikte bilgiye erişim çok kolaylaştı.
secenekler: With the spread of the Internet, access to information has become much easier.
Access to information was easier before the Internet became widespread.
The spread of the Internet has made information less reliable.
Despite the spread of the Internet, access to information is still difficult.
The Internet became widespread because information was easy to access.
aciklama: 'yaygınlaşmasıyla birlikte' = with the spread of; 'çok kolaylaştı' = has become much easier.

soru: Dinozorların büyük bir göktaşı çarpması sonucu yok olduğu düşünülüyor.
secenekler: It has been proved that dinosaurs died out because of a disease.
Scientists think that another meteorite will hit the Earth soon.
Dinosaurs are thought to have died out as a result of a large meteorite impact.
Dinosaurs survived a large meteorite impact.
A large meteorite impact is thought to have been caused by dinosaurs.
aciklama: '…yok olduğu düşünülüyor' = are thought to have died out; 'sonucu' = as a result of.

soru: Bazı öğrenciler sabah çalışmayı tercih ederken bazıları gece çalışmayı sever.
secenekler: While some students prefer to study in the morning, others like studying at night.
Most students study both in the morning and at night.
All students prefer studying at night to studying in the morning.
Students who study in the morning also like studying at night.
Some students do not like studying either in the morning or at night.
aciklama: 'bazıları … iken bazıları …' = while some ..., others ...

soru: Yaşlı insanlar yeni teknolojilere uyum sağlamakta zorlanabilir.
secenekler: New technologies are designed specifically for elderly people.
Young people have difficulty teaching new technologies to the elderly.
Elderly people refuse to use new technologies.
Elderly people adapt to new technologies more easily than young people.
Elderly people may have difficulty adapting to new technologies.
aciklama: 'uyum sağlamakta zorlanabilir' = may have difficulty adapting.

soru: Sınavı kazandığını öğrenince sevinçten ağladı.
secenekler: She was so happy that she forgot to take the exam.
She passed the exam after crying for hours.
She cried with joy when she learnt that she had passed the exam.
She cried because she had failed the exam.
She learnt that she had passed the exam, but she was not happy.
aciklama: 'kazandığını öğrenince' = when she learnt that she had passed; 'sevinçten ağladı' = cried with joy.

soru: Kimseye bir şey söylemeden evden çıktı.
secenekler: He did not leave the house because nobody spoke to him.
He left the house without saying anything to anyone.
Nobody said anything when he left the house.
He said goodbye to everyone and left the house.
He told everyone before he left the house.
aciklama: 'söylemeden' = without saying; 'kimseye bir şey' = anything to anyone.

soru: Ürünün başarısı büyük ölçüde pazarlama stratejisine bağlıdır.
secenekler: The product was successful without any marketing strategy.
A successful product does not need a marketing strategy.
The marketing strategy has little effect on the product's success.
The success of the product depends largely on its marketing strategy.
The marketing strategy depends on the success of the product.
aciklama: 'büyük ölçüde … bağlıdır' = depends largely on.

soru: Fiyatlar düşünce satışlar hızla arttı.
secenekler: Prices and sales both fell rapidly.
When prices fell, sales increased rapidly.
When sales increased, prices rose rapidly.
Sales did not change even though prices fell.
Prices fell because sales decreased rapidly.
aciklama: 'fiyatlar düşünce' = when prices fell; 'hızla arttı' = increased rapidly.

soru: Yarın yapılacak olan seçim ülkenin geleceğini belirleyecek.
secenekler: The future of the country will determine who wins the election.
The election held yesterday determined the future of the country.
The election has been postponed until tomorrow.
The election that will be held tomorrow will determine the future of the country.
The country will hold an election in the near future.
aciklama: 'yarın yapılacak olan seçim' = the election that will be held tomorrow; 'belirleyecek' = will determine.

soru: Evden çıkmadan önce ışıkları kapatmayı unutma.
secenekler: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you leave the house.
I forgot to turn off the lights when I left the house.
Don't turn off the lights when you leave the house.
Remember that you turned off the lights before you left the house.
Turn on the lights before you enter the house.
aciklama: 'kapatmayı unutma' = don't forget to turn off; emir kipidir.

soru: Açıklamada, kazada kimsenin yaralanmadığı belirtildi.
secenekler: Nobody made a statement after the accident.
No statement was made about the accident.
The statement said that no one had been injured in the accident.
The statement said that the accident had been caused by an injured driver.
The statement said that several people had been injured in the accident.
aciklama: 'kimsenin yaralanmadığı belirtildi' = said that no one had been injured.

soru: Bu yıl kış geçen yıldan daha sert geçti.
secenekler: This winter was the mildest in years.
Last year's winter was harsher than this year's.
The winter will be harsher next year.
This year's winter was as mild as last year's.
This year the winter was harsher than last year.
aciklama: 'geçen yıldan daha sert' = harsher than last year.

soru: Uzmanlar bile bu sorunun cevabını bilmiyor.
secenekler: Experts know the answer, but they do not want to share it.
Even experts do not know the answer to this question.
Experts asked this question to find the answer.
This question is so easy that even children know the answer.
Only experts know the answer to this question.
aciklama: 'uzmanlar bile' = even experts; 'bilmiyor' = do not know.

soru: Muhalefet hükümeti ekonomiyi kötü yönetmekle suçladı.
secenekler: The opposition accused the government of mismanaging the economy.
The opposition and the government worked together on the economy.
The opposition praised the government for managing the economy well.
The government admitted that it had mismanaged the economy.
The government accused the opposition of mismanaging the economy.
aciklama: 'X'i … yönetmekle suçladı' = accused X of mismanaging. Suçlayan muhalefettir.

soru: Hava güneşli olduğu hâlde deniz çok soğuk.
secenekler: It is sunny and the sea is warm enough to swim.
Because it is sunny, the sea is warm.
The sea is very cold because it is not sunny.
Although it is sunny, the sea is very cold.
The sea became cold after the sun went down.
aciklama: '…olduğu hâlde' = although; 'deniz çok soğuk' = the sea is very cold.

soru: Projenin belirlenen sürede tamamlanması mümkün görünmüyor.
secenekler: It seems possible to complete the project earlier than planned.
The project was completed before the deadline.
The project will certainly be completed on time.
The deadline for the project has been extended.
It does not seem possible for the project to be completed within the set time.
aciklama: 'mümkün görünmüyor' = does not seem possible; 'belirlenen sürede' = within the set time.

soru: Hiçbir şey olmamış gibi davranmaya devam etti.
secenekler: He behaved badly because something terrible had happened.
He explained everything that had happened.
He continued to behave as if nothing had happened.
Nothing happened, so he behaved as usual.
He stopped behaving normally after something happened.
aciklama: 'hiçbir şey olmamış gibi' = as if nothing had happened; 'davranmaya devam etti' = continued to behave.

soru: Bildiğim kadarıyla müze pazartesi günleri kapalı.
secenekler: I do not know when the museum is closed.
I know for sure that the museum is open on Mondays.
The museum is closed every day except Monday.
As far as I know, the museum is closed on Mondays.
The museum was closed last Monday, so I could not visit it.
aciklama: 'bildiğim kadarıyla' = as far as I know.

soru: Emekli olduktan sonra köye taşınmaya karar verdi.
secenekler: He decided to move to the village after he retired.
He retired because he wanted to move to the village.
He decided to retire after moving to the village.
He moved to the city after he retired.
He has never lived in a village.
aciklama: 'emekli olduktan sonra' = after he retired; 'taşınmaya karar verdi' = decided to move.

soru: Otobüs geç geldiği için derse zamanında yetişemedim.
secenekler: I arrived on time although the bus was late.
I got to class early because the bus came on time.
The bus was late because I could not get to class.
I missed the bus, so I walked to class.
I could not get to class on time because the bus came late.
aciklama: 'geç geldiği için' = because the bus came late; 'yetişemedim' = could not get to ... on time.

soru: Son veriler, ekonominin yavaşladığı yönündeki endişeleri artırdı.
secenekler: The economy slowed down because of concerns about the latest data.
The latest data were not published because of economic concerns.
The latest data have increased concerns that the economy is slowing down.
Concerns about the economy have decreased thanks to the latest data.
The latest data show that the economy is growing faster than expected.
aciklama: 'yavaşladığı yönündeki endişeler' = concerns that the economy is slowing down; 'artırdı' = have increased.

soru: Yeni işime alışmam birkaç hafta sürdü.
secenekler: I used to work at my new job a few weeks ago.
It took me a few weeks to get used to my new job.
I left my new job after a few weeks.
I got used to my new job immediately.
I have been looking for a new job for a few weeks.
aciklama: 'alışmam birkaç hafta sürdü' = it took me a few weeks to get used to.

soru: Işıklar yandığına göre evde biri olmalı.
secenekler: If there is someone at home, the lights will be on.
The lights are on although there is nobody at home.
Someone turned on the lights before leaving home.
There cannot be anyone at home because the lights are off.
Since the lights are on, there must be someone at home.
aciklama: 'yandığına göre' = since the lights are on; 'biri olmalı' = there must be someone.

soru: Öğretmen öğrencilerden ödevlerini cuma gününe kadar teslim etmelerini istedi.
secenekler: The teacher collected the homework on Friday.
The teacher told the students that there would be no homework on Friday.
The teacher asked the students to hand in their homework by Friday.
The students asked the teacher to give them homework on Friday.
The students handed in their homework after Friday.
aciklama: '…teslim etmelerini istedi' = asked the students to hand in; 'cuma gününe kadar' = by Friday.

soru: Kimse bu kuralın neden konduğunu açıklayamadı.
secenekler: Nobody could explain why this rule had been introduced.
Everybody understood why this rule had been introduced.
This rule was introduced without any explanation from the government.
The rule was explained, but nobody accepted it.
Nobody obeyed the rule because it was not explained.
aciklama: 'kimse … açıklayamadı' = nobody could explain; 'neden konduğunu' = why it had been introduced.

soru: Yemekten sonra parkta kısa bir yürüyüş yaptık.
secenekler: We did not go for a walk because we had eaten too much.
We had a meal in the park after a short walk.
We had lunch in the park instead of going for a walk.
After the meal, we went for a short walk in the park.
Before the meal, we walked in the park for a long time.
aciklama: 'yemekten sonra' = after the meal; 'kısa bir yürüyüş yaptık' = went for a short walk.

soru: Aşırı avlanma birçok balık türünün neslinin tükenmesine yol açtı.
secenekler: Overfishing has had no effect on fish species.
Overfishing has led to the extinction of many fish species.
The extinction of many fish species has led to overfishing.
Fishing has been banned to protect endangered species.
Many fish species have increased in number despite overfishing.
aciklama: '…e yol açtı' = has led to; neden aşırı avlanmadır.

soru: Hastane içinde sigara içmek kesinlikle yasaktır.
secenekler: Smoking is allowed only in certain areas of the hospital.
Smoking outside the hospital is forbidden.
The hospital provides special rooms for smokers.
Patients are advised to stop smoking before entering the hospital.
Smoking is strictly forbidden inside the hospital.
aciklama: 'kesinlikle yasaktır' = is strictly forbidden; 'hastane içinde' = inside the hospital.

soru: Ne kadar zengin olursa olsun, parayla mutluluk satın alamaz.
secenekler: He is not rich, so he cannot buy happiness.
He became happy after he became rich.
However rich he may be, he cannot buy happiness with money.
Because he is rich, he can buy anything he wants, including happiness.
Rich people are always happier than poor people.
aciklama: 'ne kadar zengin olursa olsun' = however rich he may be; 'satın alamaz' = cannot buy.

soru: Şüpheli, sonunda parayı kendisinin çaldığını itiraf etti.
secenekler: The suspect confessed that he knew who had stolen the money.
The suspect claimed that someone else had stolen the money.
The police found the stolen money in the suspect's house.
The suspect finally confessed that he had stolen the money himself.
The suspect denied that he had stolen the money.
aciklama: '…çaldığını itiraf etti' = confessed that he had stolen; 'kendisinin' = himself.

soru: Bu film iki kez izlenmeye değer.
secenekler: I have watched this film twice.
This film is worth watching twice.
This film is too long to watch twice.
You should watch this film twice to understand it.
This film is not worth watching even once.
aciklama: 'izlenmeye değer' = is worth watching.

soru: Elektrikli araçlar, benzinli araçlara kıyasla çok daha az bakım gerektirir.
secenekler: Compared with petrol cars, electric vehicles require much less maintenance.
Maintaining electric vehicles is more difficult than maintaining petrol cars.
Electric vehicles require as much maintenance as petrol cars.
Petrol cars require much less maintenance than electric vehicles.
Electric vehicles are much cheaper to buy than petrol cars.
aciklama: 'benzinli araçlara kıyasla' = compared with petrol cars; 'çok daha az bakım' = much less maintenance.
